svg.title: Three-colour DFS trace on the build-step graph
svg.desc: Run on the six real edges, without 4 to 1. Each row shows the colour of vertices 0 to 5 after the event (plain WHITE, amber GRAY on the current path, green BLACK finished), and the postorder list. Reversed postorder is 5 0 2 1 3 4.
svg.text: three-colour DFS on the six edges (no 4 → 1)
reversed: [5, 0, 2, 1, 3, 4], every edge u → v has u before v
